title: Odoo System Admin
tagline: Run Odoo safely for your whole company: users, access rights, security groups, companies, languages, Studio and backups.
description: For administrators, IT staff and power users responsible for an Odoo database. No programming is required.

You will learn Odoo’s administration settings, how to manage users, how access rights and security groups control what each person can see and do, and how to set up multiple companies and languages. You will also adapt screens with Odoo Studio and keep your data safe with backups. A downloadable admin guide supports every topic, and a final assessment confirms your skills.
learningOutcomes: Control access with access rights and security groups
Customize forms and apps with Odoo Studio, without code
Protect your data with database backups
whoItsFor: Experienced end users taking on more responsibility for the system and its users
Office administrators managing internal structure, access, and operational settings
ERP support teams resolving common user, data, permission, and configuration issues
Operations leads maintaining reliable workflows across teams and departments
requirements: Basic Odoo navigation and end-user experience
Understanding of at least one business workflow

faq.question: Does this course teach server administration?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on administering Odoo itself: users, access, companies, languages, Studio and backups. Server hosting is outside its scope.

faq.question: Do I need to know Python?
faq.answer: No. Everything is done through Odoo’s settings and Studio.

faq.question: Is this a prerequisite for implementation?
faq.answer: It is not mandatory, but it gives a valuable foundation for learners moving into implementation work.

faq.question: Will I learn to design access for different roles?
faq.answer: Yes. Access rights and security groups each have dedicated lessons.
